references.text: Israel camped in the Wilderness of Paran before the spies were sent out, providing geographical context for their return to the same place.
The spies were sent out from the Wilderness of Paran, and they are now returning to the same place to give their report.
Kadesh is mentioned as an important place in the wilderness where the congregation of Israel gathered, the same place to which the spies returned.
A reference back to when Moses sent spies from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land.
Moses recounts the story of the spies who were sent from Kadesh-barnea and returned with fruit from the land.
Caleb refers to when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land.
Describes the fruit the spies brought back from the land, which they now show to the congregation.
Kadesh is linked to Israel's journey through the wilderness and God's guidance of the people.
